## Acceptance Criteria → Test Case Coverage
| AC | Criterion | Test cases | Covered |
|----|-----------|------------|---------|
| AC-1 | `GET /api/articles` (global feed + author/tag/favorited/limit/offset filters) and `GET /api/articles/feed` (personal feed) as Route Handlers | TC-API-01, TC-API-02, TC-API-03, TC-API-04, TC-API-05, TC-E2E-01, TC-E2E-02 | ✅ |
| AC-2 | `POST /api/articles`, `GET/PUT/DELETE /api/articles/:slug` full CRUD incl. slug generation + tag association | TC-API-06, TC-API-07, TC-API-08, TC-API-09, TC-API-10, TC-API-11, TC-API-12, TC-API-13, TC-API-14, TC-INT-01, TC-INT-02, TC-INT-06, TC-SEC-01, TC-SEC-02, TC-SEC-03, TC-SEC-04, TC-E2E-01 | ✅ |
| AC-3 | `GET /api/tags` returns all tags | TC-API-15, TC-INT-01, TC-INT-02, TC-E2E-01 | ✅ |
| AC-4 | N+1 enrichment loop replaced by Sequelize eager `include`; bounded query count per feed request independent of article count | TC-INT-03, TC-INT-04, TC-INT-05, TC-INT-06, TC-PERF-01, TC-PERF-02, TC-PERF-03, TC-E2E-01 | ✅ |
| AC-5 | Every response shape (incl. error format `{ errors: { body: [...] } }`) matches the existing Conduit/RealWorld spec exactly, verified old-vs-new across CRUD + both feeds | TC-API-09, TC-API-11, TC-API-16, TC-PERF-03, TC-SEC-04, TC-SEC-05 | ✅ |

**Coverage check**: 5/5 acceptance criteria have at least one happy-path AND at least one
negative/boundary test case. ✅

Per-AC happy vs negative/boundary confirmation:
- AC-1: happy TC-API-01/02/04, E2E-01/02; negative/boundary TC-API-03 (pagination boundaries), TC-API-05 (feed auth 401).
- AC-2: happy TC-API-06/10/12/13; negative/boundary TC-API-07 (tricky slugs), TC-API-08 (no auth), TC-API-09 (missing fields), TC-API-11 (404), TC-API-14 (non-author forbidden).
- AC-3: happy TC-API-15; negative TC-API-15 method-not-allowed sub-check + TC-INT-02 (tag removal not surfacing).
- AC-4: happy TC-INT-03/04/05; boundary/regression TC-PERF-01/02 (N=1 vs N=50 query count), TC-PERF-03 (latency vs old).
- AC-5: happy TC-API-16 (parity across all ops); negative TC-API-09/11 (error-envelope parity), TC-SEC-05 (no leak in errors).

## Open Questions
- TO CONFIRM: Auth header scheme expected by the ported handlers — `Token <jwt>` vs `Bearer <jwt>` (dev). [api TC-API cases, all security cases]
- TO CONFIRM: `POST /api/articles` success status — 200 vs 201 — must match old backend (dev / verified in TC-API-16).
- TO CONFIRM: `DELETE /api/articles/:slug` success status — 200 vs 204 — must match old backend (TC-API-13/16).
- TO CONFIRM: Status for an unknown slug — 404 vs 422 — must match old backend (TC-API-11/16).
- TO CONFIRM: Whether a non-author edit/delete returns 403 or 401 in the old backend (parity — TC-API-14, TC-SEC-03).
- TO CONFIRM: `limit=0` and non-numeric pagination param handling (default vs 422 vs empty) (BA/dev — TC-API-03).
- TO CONFIRM: Slug uniqueness strategy for duplicate titles — random suffix vs sequence (dev — TC-API-07).
- TO CONFIRM: Whether a title change on PUT regenerates the slug (dev — TC-API-12).
- TO CONFIRM: Method-not-allowed behaviour for non-GET on `/api/tags` (dev — TC-API-15).
- TO CONFIRM: The committed bounded query-count ceiling per list/feed request from REQ-NF-02 (e.g. "≤ 5 queries") (dev/BA — TC-PERF-01/02).
- TO CONFIRM: Absolute latency target from REQ-NF-04, if any, and acceptable regression margin vs old backend (BA — TC-PERF-03).
- TO CONFIRM: How the team wants SQL query counts observed if Postgres `log_statement` / `pg_stat_statements` are unavailable (dev — performance plan preamble).
- TO CONFIRM: Whether an orphaned tag (used by zero articles after a delete) should remain in or drop from `/api/tags` (dev/BA — TC-INT-06).
- TO CONFIRM: Availability of the follow endpoint (`POST /api/profiles/:username/follow`) in this build; if not present, seed the follow relationship directly in the DB (TC-E2E-02, TC-INT-03).
- TO CONFIRM: How to mint an expired JWT for the token-rejection case, or mark it unverifiable (dev — TC-SEC-02).
